The menu

Served all day, every day. Prices include everything — no surprises at the till.

Allergies or a special request? Add a note when you send your order and we will sort it out.

A small café with one simple rule

Noor started in 2019 as a two-table coffee corner. The rule then is the rule now: if we would not serve it to family, it does not go on the menu.

Our beans come from small farms in Ethiopia and Brazil, roasted in Doha every week. Bread and pastries are baked in-house each morning — when they are gone, they are gone.
